changes.comment: A workflow status/list read or a cron list made while its dispatcher is stopping or its Team is dissolving is now refused instead of answered: WorkflowService and SchedulerService fence those reads behind the same admission gate their mutations already crossed. A leader-scoped mutation racing both a dispatcher stop and a Team dissolve at the same time now reports TeamClosedError instead of ServerShuttingDownError, now that the TeamLeader handle is assembled from surfaces that already fence themselves instead of forwarding through 12 hand-written closures. Internally, several resources a parent used to build and hand down (the Workflow journal, the Agent admission ledger, the per-Team record handle) are now built by the module that owns them instead; persisted record and config shapes are unchanged.
